name: linear-governance-hub
description: Enterprise triage & issue orchestration with cryptographic audit trails for Linear. contest:round2

actions.name: create_issue
actions.description: Draft and create a new Linear issue with team assignment and priority.

actions.name: update_priority
actions.description: Escalate or downgrade an issue's priority level.

actions.name: assign_user
actions.description: Assign an issue to an engineering team member.

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Append audit context or discussion notes to an active issue.

actions.name: transition_status
actions.description: Move an issue through workflow states (Triage -> Todo -> In Progress -> Done).

actions.name: close_sprint_issue
actions.description: Complete and close an issue with an optional final resolution summary.

actions.name: attach_signed_log
actions.description: Attach a cryptographic execution trace or incident log directly to the issue.
